LESSON: ULUM AL- QUR’AN MIRACULOUS NATURE OF THE QUR’AN THE QUR’AN QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is the Qur’an considered a miracle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman
2. explain the language of the Qur’an for better understanding
3. identify different styles of the Qur’an for better understanding

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the language of the Qur’an for better understanding
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the language of the Qur’an for better understanding. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. identify different styles of the Qur’an for better understanding
   In simple words: practise until you can identify different styles of the Qur’an for better understanding. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an in the examples.
2. Explain Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.
4. Show that you can: describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Research online/read from available reference materials on the characteristics of a miracle and make notes,
2. Discuss the miraculous nature of the Qur’an and present on charts/PowerPoint,
3. Research online/read from available reference materials on the language of the Qur’an and make class presentations,
4. Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the skill of interpretation and inference is enhanced as learners discuss the miraculous nature of the Qur’an in groups.
5. Digital Literacy: the skill of interacting with digital devices is enhanced when learners research online on the language of the Qur’an.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the Qur’an considered a miracle?
2. How does the language and style of the Qur’an help in its interpretation?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman
2. explain the language of the Qur’an for better understanding
3. identify different styles of the Qur’an for better understanding

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
